set.body:
Consumer: PLS Neuro viewer bd-01M23RG0ED4BXVPT9KT18R135Y, user feedback 2026-09-09. Public existing L/Row/Column layouts preserve aspect but the app uses a width>=2height heuristic, wasting space. No public single-plane presentation exists.

Scope: renderer-neutral image-view adaptive arrangement based on fitted physical slice area, device-space margins/gaps that survive resize, and explicit single-plane visibility. Preserve cursor, per-plane zoom/pan, convention and display state; only displayed planes should render/sample and receive picks. Existing fixed layouts and three-plane receipt identity remain compatible. Application selector/persistence/integration stays with consumer owner.

Acceptance: shared JVM+JS public-API tests on realistic anisotropic anatomy, portrait/square/wide resizes, exhaustive candidate fit area, bounds/gaps/aspect invariants, all three focus choices, visible-only pointer actions and sampling, focus-to-all state preservation. Compile relevant renderer consumers. Native consumer screenshot/picking/resize review is a separate required integration gate; do not call provider tests final UI acceptance.
set.title: Adapt orthogonal slices to viewport space and support native single-plane focus
